introHtml: Rainbow pet toys bring a pop of color to any pet event or promotional giveaway. Whether you're outfitting a dog park grand opening or handing out swag at a Pride parade, these vibrant toys stand out. Choose from rubber fetch toys, plush squeakers, or rope tugs, all customizable with your logo. The multicolor design hides dirt well and appeals to pet owners who love bright, cheerful accessories for their furry friends.
